audit.why: Olaf owning 1-3 and 6, the lane levelling at 4-5 and again at first item, matches 50.4% Emerald+ over 1336 games and both on-disk charts. Charts untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes read 'Ragnarok online, level 6, first item' with no numbers and gave Akali 'levels 2-3'.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is not learnable before level 3. Ragnarok is 100/90/80s, and it also passively grants Olaf armour and magic resist at all times - so his level-6 spike is defensive as well as offensive, which changes whether your first-item burst actually one-shots him.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes, phases[4].why and content whys[4] and whys[5] rebuilt on the 100s and the passive resists.

audit.whatIsWrong: Olaf's W is called 'Vicious Strikes' and described as omnivamp in six separate places across the content layer. His R is credited with giving him true damage. Undertow's cooldown reset is never given a number.
audit.why: Riot's kit: W is Tough It Out - attack speed and a shield, no lifesteal at all. Olaf's sustain comes from Berserker Rage, which gives attack speed and life steal scaling with his MISSING health, and from Reckless Swing refunding its self-damage on a kill. The true damage is Reckless Swing (E, 11/10/9/8/7s, 325 range), not Ragnarok. And Ragnarok's disable immunity holds only for as long as he keeps attacking - break off and it stops mattering. Undertow is 9s flat but the cooldown fully resets when he picks the axe back up, which is the actual reason his chase never ends: denying the pickup is the counterplay and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: content early, mid, late, whys[2], whys[4], whys[5], spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text, spikes[3].text, wants.foe[1], wants.foe[2] and full-layer tldr, report[0].t, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, dontsFull[1].d and report[11].t all corrected.

edits.before: Olaf owns these levels — his Q (Undertow) throws an axe that slows you, and picking it back up refunds most of its cooldown so he keeps re-throwing and closing the gap, while his E (Reckless Swing) chunks you for flat true damage at melee range. You have no Shroud charge to spare and no R execute yet, so don't try to walk-trade or stand on his Q slow. Last-hit at the tip of your Q (Five Point Strike) and concede the chip — any extended brawl just feeds his W (Vicious Strikes) omnivamp.
edits.after: Olaf owns these levels — his Q (Undertow) throws an axe that slows you, and retrieving it resets the 9s cooldown outright so he keeps re-throwing and closing, while his E (Reckless Swing) chunks you for flat true damage at 325 range. You have no Shroud until 3 and no R execute yet, so don't walk-trade or stand on his axe slow. Last-hit at the tip of your Q (Five Point Strike) and concede the chip — any extended brawl feeds Berserker Rage's missing-health life steal.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 even out once you can afford to use Twilight Shroud (W) aggressively — drop it to break line of sight on his Q axe and reset before he commits his E. Level 6 is your window: bait his Ragnarok, because while it is active he is CC-immune, his armor/MR spike, and his on-hit true damage ignores your defenses — but the second it drops, your E (Shuriken Flip) dash into R first-cast then the missing-HP execute deletes him. Don't blow R into an active Ragnarok; wait it out behind Shroud.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 even out once you can afford to use Twilight Shroud (W) aggressively — drop it to break line of sight on his Q axe and reset before he commits his E. Level 6 is your window: bait his Ragnarok, because while it is active he ignores disables so long as he keeps attacking and his armor/MR spike — but the second it drops, your E (Shuriken Flip) dash into R first-cast then the missing-HP execute deletes him. Don't blow R into an active Ragnarok; wait it out behind Shroud.

edits.before: Your first item (Rocketbelt or Lich Bane) is your hardest all-in — Olaf typically builds bruiser with little MR, so a clean E into full combo can one-shot him before his W (Vicious Strikes) omnivamp heals it back. But he is a juggernaut, not a real scaler: he never falls off, his sustain keeps climbing, and his R still answers your burst if you mistime it, so the 2+ item stage is a coinflip on execution. Convert your 6-to-first-item lead into a tower plate or a roam, because if the game grinds long his sustain neutralizes your one-shot pattern.

But he is a juggernaut, not a real scaler: he never falls off, his sustain keeps climbing as he drops, and his R still answers your burst if you mistime it, so the 2+ item stage is a coinflip on execution. notes: 'Vicious Strikes' is a retired name for Olaf's W and it appears six times in this entry — the current ability is Tough It Out (attack speed plus a shield, no lifesteal), and his sustain is the Berserker Rage passive. Worth grepping the whole content file for 'Vicious Strikes'. Also: Olaf's kit file flags Undertow (Q) as 'grounding'; Riot's description says armour shred and slow only, so I wrote nothing claiming his axe can deny Shuriken Flip or Perfect Execution.
